guard_escalation: independent of the poll cycle: a timer fires 30s after TERM and KILLs any surviving owned-group process even if the worker identity vanished (F9)
receipt_hashing: terminal/result/marker receipts carry payload_sha256 and are validated on read; a tampered receipt is error, never complete
native_arming: supervisor-owned; this launcher claims only its independent resource guard and exposed wiring
